name: Cost of concrete vs. asphalt driveway?

mainEntity.name: Cost of concrete vs. asphalt driveway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Concrete: $8-$12/sqft (lasts 30+ yrs), Asphalt: $3-$5/sqft (lasts 15 yrs). Concrete recommended for CA heat.

description: Concrete: $8-$12/sqft (lasts 30+ yrs), Asphalt: $3-$5/sqft (lasts 15 yrs). Concrete recommended for CA heat.
